description: Appliance that heats water for a home's radiators or underfloor heating; heating-only and combi boilers are both included, and a combi boiler pack counts as one product.
Warm-air heating unit that heats air and sends it through ducts; any fuel.
Heater built of upright columns or sections; made in several materials and period styles.
Heated rail made to warm and dry towels in a bathroom; fed by hot water or electric.
Room heater that blows air over a heating element; any fuel.
Heater with an exposed bar, quartz or halogen element and a reflector.
Solid-fuel stove with a firebox vented through a flue.
Kerosene or gas room heater with no flue.
Inset or wall-hung fire vented through a flue; any fuel.
Electric mat or hot-water pipe kit sold to heat a floor.
Air-to-water heat pump that heats water for radiators or a floor.
Heat pump that draws heat from a loop buried in the ground, whatever it heats.
Indoor wall unit linked by refrigerant lines to an outdoor unit; many also heat.
Fan made to mount on a wall or clip to an edge.
Powered hand-held or neck fan; a plain folding hand fan is in Bags & Accessories.
Appliance that filters particles and pollutants from room air; tower and desktop models, with different filter grades.
Appliance that adds moisture to room air; ultrasonic, evaporative and warm-mist types.
Small-capacity dehumidifier, often a Peltier-cooled model.
Unpowered container of drying crystals that absorbs moisture from a room.
Device that switches heating or cooling on and off to hold a set temperature; smart or plain, and smart radiator heads are included.
Water heater that heats water with a compressor heat pump.
Flat-plate or evacuated-tube collector sold on its own.
Tank heated by a boiler, with no heat source of its own; indirect or buffer cylinders.
Unit that removes hardness from the home water supply; salt-based or salt-free.
Filter plumbed into the supply or fitted to a tap; whole-house, under-sink, shower and tap-mounted types. Jug filters are in Kitchen & Dining.
Fixed or freestanding tub for bathing in, in many materials and period styles.
Shower unit or set for washing under running water; electric, mixer and power types.
Basin for washing hands and face; some are sold built into their cabinet.
Powered toilet seat with a warm-water wash.
Hot tub with a moulded rigid shell and built-in heater and pumps.
Portable hot tub with an inflatable body and a plug-in heater and pump.
Wooden tub heated by a wood-burning stove.
Sauna that is set up or folded inside a home, not a cabin standing as a building.
Panel plus micro-inverter sold as one set that plugs into a home socket and feeds the grid, with no storage.
Panels, a charge controller or inverter and usually a battery, sold as one kit to power a place with no grid connection, such as a van, boat or cabin.
Rechargeable battery that stores electricity for a home; a portable power station is the carried version.
Filter made to fit an air purifier, humidifier or dehumidifier.
Salt used up in a water softener; dishwasher salt is in Cleaning & Laundry.
Cartridge made to fit a water filter or treatment unit.
Mounting frame or bracket made for solar panels.
